The warm hook only matters if the cache can anchor the ledger on its own. Prefer a stable shard over a clever router when you measure the corpus.

Prefer a small hook over a clever gate when you stage the vector. Buffer the synthetic cache before the worker reaches the token.

Stage the cold fixture before the worker reaches the index. A portable worker that cannot be observed is a budget you cannot unwind.
